causal_hypothesis: The frozen Pi0.5 full-task VLA policy undershoots the placement target: its learned trajectory stops the EEF at the caddy front compartment (y ≈ -0.15) and stalls there (stalled=1, direction cosine oscillating around 0), never advancing to the back-compartment depth (y ≈ -0.24 to -0.30) that the success comparator reaches. The book is consequently released in the wrong compartment. This is a VLA policy undershoot, not a scripted-servo singularity (no move_to/IK was ever called).
mechanism_change: Add one critic/recovery pair that detects the placement-undershoot stall (EEF stalled at the caddy front compartment, y in [-0.18,-0.10], while the book is still held, gripper opening <= 0.05) and, on trigger, hands off to an authoritative full-task VLA recovery with unit scales and 5-action replanning to test whether a fresh replanning window can advance depth to the back compartment. This is a bounded provisional hypothesis test of the accepted root cause (VLA placement-depth undershoot), not a claim that the diagnosis is conclusive.
validation_plan: Paired same-seed live gate: run the frozen Pi0.5 full-task policy with the new critic/recovery active versus the frozen policy alone on the same seed. The critic must fire on the placement-undershoot failures (book held through the stall at y ~ -0.15) and NOT fire on the success episode (EEF advances past y=-0.18) nor on the early-slip failure (bc9c69b9, grip drifts to 0.059). Attribution is measured by paired_gate_result.candidate_interventions vs successful_candidate_interventions: a rescue is only counted if the recovery intervention executes and the episode subsequently reaches official libero termination. If the authoritative full-task recovery executes but produces zero attributed rescues, the next refinement switches the recovery mechanism to the audited Actor-only semantic tool (move_to toward the back compartment) rather than another prompt-only variant.

critic_rules.title: Placement undershoot: EEF stalled at caddy front compartment while book still held
critic_rules.proposal: The EEF has stalled at the caddy front compartment (y ~ -0.15) with the book still held (gripper opening <= 0.05), matching the placement-undershoot signature: the frozen VLA stops advancing depth and emits oscillatory near-zero-progress commands. Hand off to an authoritative full-task VLA recovery to test whether a fresh replanning window can advance to the back compartment.

recovery_rules.title: Authoritative full-task VLA replanning to advance placement depth
recovery_rules.precondition: Critic fired: EEF stalled at caddy front compartment (y in [-0.18,-0.10]) with book held (gripper opening <= 0.05) and step_index >= 150.

parameters.prompt: pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

steps.stop_when: official libero termination (success) or episode truncation or max_chunks exhausted

safety_constraints: Unit scales preserved; no reduction of translation/rotation/gripper/clip scales without candidate-specific evidence.
No absolute coordinates are passed to the VLA; the recovery uses only the authoritative language instruction.
Official environment termination remains the sole success criterion.
recovery_rules.stop_condition: official libero termination (success) or episode truncation or max_chunks exhausted
recovery_rules.fallback: If this authoritative full-task VLA recovery executes but produces zero attributed rescues across at least two rejected same-seed gates, switch the recovery mechanism to the audited Actor-only semantic tool (move_to toward the back compartment) rather than another prompt-only variant.
